title: Arrived with a Small Defect
text:
Arrived with a Small Defect. Update After Receiving Replacement: The second set was worse than the first, as this time both pans had small defects. I uploaded 3 pictures of the second set. On the 12" of the replacement set, there was a sharp edge along the rim which you can easily feel if you run your finger across.

Original Review: The bad first. The 10" Pan arrived with a small defect on its rim. At this expensive price, the pans should be absolutely perfect immediately out of the box. The Zavor company was very nice about it and communicated with me fast. I boxed up the pans and ordered a replacement via Amazon...and you gotta love Amazon for their service, of course.

The good: The pans are very nice, and the fact they offer removable handles which makes the pans not take up as much room in your cabinet as other pans, is really a welcome and useful feature. The handles are soft to the touch. The pans feel like the perfect weight...not too heavy.
